rawContent: Women have endured "awkward" situations for years. Little girls have been destroyed by evil. And we worry about gossip? The #metoo and #churchtoo are not about gossip. They are exposure of evil. So we can be washed clean in Jesus.

Dealing with memories. Heard these words by Josh Groban. "Everybody wants to be heard. Dont give up. Because you are loved." Just what I needed to hear. #metoo #churchtoo #spiritualabuse #survivor #csasurvivor
@pinthecreep @RachelintheOC For me it was painful to realize those in my life who were not really safe with my story. #metoo brought out the worst in some people. #metoochat

I have learned to be compassionate with them. My husband found out just 6 years ago about me. He's had a lifetime of belief that women lie, make up stuff, etc. For him he didn't believe me at first, because he couldn't Grasp what happened. #metoo #metoochat https://t.co/sivN9NC2s2

Once he grasped it, then we could talk. He is overwhelmed by the #metoo movement. Because he knows the damage first hand. But he still has a long ways to go. Sometimes I just have to walk away. #metoochat
